The Unstucking Academy

When you're ready to go deeper, with other people.

A membership that combines a step-by-step curriculum, live practice sessions with me, and a small private community. It's for people who are maxed out on wellness content and tired of dead ends.

Deep learning

If you like the teaching style from the podcast, you'll love the depth and guided application inside the Academy. You'll always have an answer to "how?" and "why?"

Live guidance

Beyond the lessons and guided practices on the Unstucking Pathway, you'll meet with me and other students in live skills practices, cohorts, and Q&As.

A small community

The Academy stays small on purpose, capped at 100 members. You'll connect with the same small group throughout your time here, so you won't disappear in a crowd.

Real change

The Academy is built so you won't need the Academy. Change doesn't happen in a 21-day "reset" or a one-time "hack." It comes from learning the skills and practicing them until they're yours.

Explore the Unstucking Academy

The app

A self-regulation practice built for you.

The Stuck Not Broken app meets you where you are: you tell it how you're doing, and it builds a custom meditation for the state you're actually in. Every check-in and every practice changes what it gives you next, so it adapts as you do. Free to use.

Meet Justin

Why me?

I'm a therapist and coach who thinks mental health needs a simpler, more accessible language, one that doesn't lean on abstract psychobabble or woo-woo. I've spent years making Polyvagal Theory something you can actually understand and use, on the podcast, in three books, and with members of the Academy.

My whole approach is anti-hack: practice over protocol, integration over intervention. I keep data, I ask for feedback constantly, and I'd rather you graduate than stay forever.

More about Justin →
  • Licensed Marriage & Family Therapist (since 2009)
  • Polyvagal Institute Editorial Board member
  • Host of the Stuck Not Broken podcast (since 2019)
  • Author of three books on applying Polyvagal Theory
  • Creator of the Polyvagal Current model
Work with me one-to-one

Sometimes you want a little extra.

You can make real progress with the free and paid options above. But if you want my full focus on you and your nervous system, we can work together directly. No packages, no minimums.

Therapy (LMFT)

1:1, couples, or family therapy with me, specializing in trauma. California residents only. Insurance not accepted.

$150 /sessionLearn more →

Coaching

1:1 sessions to build your custom unstucking plan: your concerns, current efforts, safety level, stuck state, goals, and homework. Zero pressure to continue.

$150 /sessionLearn more →

Professional consultation

For therapists and practitioners applying Polyvagal Theory to specific clients. Bring a case, leave with a direction.

$200 /sessionLearn more →

Speaking

Keynotes and workshops that make complex neuroscience simple and actionable, tailored to your audience.

By requestLearn more →

However you got here, I'm glad you did. Start with something free, take your time, and come back when you're ready for more. There's no wrong place to begin.
